outline:
提醒:本課程為全英語授課，對學生英語程度要求高，需要經常以英語回答問題，每節課皆有全英文口頭報告的環節。

本課程探討了材料性質，並將其與海洋工程相關聯，特別關注船舶材料、潛艦材料及其在海洋工程中的應用。課程將強調材料行為的理論探討，涵蓋塑性變形、強化機制、斷裂力學、蠕變和疲勞、熱容量、熱膨脹、熱傳導、電解定律、電解導電性、離子活性、可逆電極電位、不可逆電極過程、電化學測量、相變動力學、擴散、Kirkendall效應、合金系統的熱力學性質，以及表面和界面的熱力學。

Reminder: This is an international students friendly course. Domestic students are required to use full English to answer questions, do the presentation and write exam sheets.

The properties of materials in service will be discussed in detail. Special focus will be on the theoretically discussion of the behavior of materials. Topics covered include plastic deformation、strengthening mechanisms、fracture、creep and fatigue、heat capacity、thermal expansion、thermal conductivity、the law of electrolysis、electrolytic conductance and transport, and ionic activity、reversible electrode potentials、Irreversible electrode processes、electrochemical measurements、kinetics of phase transformation、diffusion、kirkendall effect、thermodynamic properties of alloy systems、thermodynamics of surfaces and interfaces
schedule:
課程安排：

模組1：海洋材料的結構和變形

第2-3週
介紹在海洋工程中使用的材料的結構和變形。
模組2：海洋工程材料概覽

第4-5週
概述在造船和潛艦建造中常用的材料。
模組3：海洋環境中的機械測試

第6-7週
檢視機械測試方法及其在海洋材料中的應用。
模組4：海洋應用中的應力-應變關係

第9-11週
深入研究應力-應變關係及其在海洋工程中的重要性。
模組5：海洋結構中的斷裂力學

第12-13週
了解斷裂力學及其對海洋結構完整性的重要性。
模組6：塑性理論及其在海洋應用中

第14-16週
探討塑性理論及其在海洋材料設計中的應用。
考試：

期中考試：第8週
期末考試：第17週

Course Schedule:

Module 1: Structure and Deformation in Marine Materials

Weeks 2-3
Introduction to the structure and deformation of materials used in marine engineering.
Module 2: Survey of Marine Engineering Materials

Weeks 4-5
An overview of materials commonly employed in shipbuilding and submarine construction.
Module 3: Mechanical Testing in Marine Environments

Weeks 6-7
Examination of mechanical testing methods and their application to marine materials.
Module 4: Stress-Strain Relationships in Marine Applications

Weeks 9-11
In-depth study of stress-strain relationships and their significance in marine engineering.
Module 5: Fracture Mechanics in Marine Structures

Weeks 12-13
Understanding fracture mechanics and its relevance to the integrity of marine structures.
Module 6: Theory of Plasticity and Marine Applications

Weeks 14-16
Exploration of plasticity theory and its application in marine material design.
Examinations:

Mid-term Exam: Week 8
Final Exam: Week 17
Note: Domestic students are required to use English for all coursework, including answering questions, presentations, and exam papers.

This course provides a comprehensive understanding of materials used in marine engineering, offering valuable insights into ship and submarine construction, maintenance, and performance in marine environments. Students will gain the knowledge and skills necessary to work with advanced materials for maritime applications.
